name: YFG Asak [Flux | Krea]
description: YFG Asak: Retro Futurism YFG Asak fuses a vintage, retro-futuristic vision—highlighting 1970s color palettes (think bold reds and punchy yellows) with crisp, modern lines reminiscent of Japanese futurism. This LoRA can be quite strong, so balancing weight may be necessary to preserve or emphasize key elements of your prompt. Key Features Retro-Futuristic Fusion Bold color blocks—reds, yellows, and warmer tones—evoking 1970s design aesthetics. Subtle Japanese influences in architecture, costumes, or environment details. Sharp Details & Crisp Lines Generates sleek, clean-edged visuals with a vintage-yet-modern vibe. Perfect for concept art that mixes nostalgic styling with forward-thinking elements. Flexibility vs. Strength Model can be overpowering at higher strengths, possibly leading to “hallucinations.” Lowering to 0.25 or so may be necessary for a more balanced look; or you may prefer stronger settings for bold, saturated results. Prompt Sensitivity Sometimes, the model ignores parts of a prompt or specific characters; tweaking seeds and weight can mitigate this. The trigger word, “YFG-Asak,” can help reinforce the retro-futuristic effect but isn’t always needed. Recommended Usage Trigger / Prompt Word Use “YFG-Asak” if you want to explicitly call upon this style, though it’s often optional. LoRA Weight Ranging from 0.25 (subtle infusion) to 1.0 (maximum effect). Ideal Subjects Retro sci-fi cityscapes, vintage-meets-future vehicles, characters dressed in 70s-inspired futuristic attire, etc. Complementary Prompts “1970s retro,” “bold color blocks,” “Japanese modernism,” “futuristic architecture,” “angled lines,” “mono-color background.” Tips & Tricks Balance Is Key Lower the LoRA strength if you want to retain other style or subject details. Increase the strength to push YFG Asak’s nostalgic futurism front and center. Color Emphasis YFG Asak naturally leans toward reds and yellows. If you need other colors, prompt explicitly for them (e.g., “blue neon accents”). Experiment With Seeds If a character or object fails to appear, seed hunting can help lock in a consistent outcome. Adjusting prompt structure or rephrasing can also reinforce specific details. Stylistic Pairings Combine with other LoRAs or style prompts for novel fusions—like retro-futuristic cyberpunk or minimal line art with bright color bursts. YFG Asak delivers a vibrant blend of 70s flair and Japanese futurism, leveraging crisp geometry, vivid reds and yellows, and a healthy dose of sci-fi nostalgia. Adjust strength, experiment with prompts, and discover your perfect retro-future balance!
